_intent.depositId,\n            _intent.paymentMethod,\n            _intent.fiatCurrency\n        );\n        if (minConversionRate == 0) revert CurrencyNotSupported(_intent.paymentMethod,     revert TakerNotWhitelisted(_intent.escrow, _intent.depositId, _intent.paymentMethod, msg.sender);\n            }\n            if (_intent.groupId != bytes32(0)) (,,,,, arbitrator) = abi.encodePacked(\n                    address(this),    // Include orchestrator address for avoiding collisions when migrating to a new orchestrator\n                    // or when multiple orchestrators are deployed\n                    intentCounter     // unique counter within this orchestrator\n                )\n            ));\n        intentHash = bytes32(intermediateHash % function _calculateAndTransferFees(\n        IERC20 _token,\n        bytes32 _intentHash,\n        Intent memory _intent,\n        uint256 _releaseAmount,\n        address _managerFeeRecipient,\n        uint256 _managerFee\n    ) internal returns (uint256 netFees) {\n        uint256 protocolFeeAmount;\n        uint256 referralFeeAmount;\n        uint256 managerFeeAmount;\n\n        // Calculate protocol fee (taken from taker) - based on release amount\n        if (protocolFeeRecipient != address(0) && protocolFee > 0) {\n            protocolFeeAmount = (_releaseAmount * protocolFee) / PRECISE_UNIT;\n            _token.safeTransfer(protocolFeeRecipient, protocolFeeAmount);\n        }\n\n        // Calculate referral fees (taken from taker) - based on release amount\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _intent.referralFees.length; ++i) {\n            IReferralFee.ReferralFee memory referralFee = _intent.referralFees[i];\n            uint256 feeAmount = (_releaseAmount * referralFee.fee) / PRECISE_UNIT;\n            referralFeeAmount += feeAmount;\n            _token.safeTransfer(referralFee.recipient, feeAmount);\n            emit IntentReferralFeeDistributed(_intentHash, referralFee.recipient, feeAmount);\n        }\n\n        // Calculate manager fee (taken from taker) - based on release amount\n        if (_managerFeeRecipient != address(0) && _managerFee > 0) {\n            managerFeeAmount = (_releaseAmount * _managerFee) / PRECISE_UNIT;\n            _token.safeTransfer(_managerFeeRecipient, managerFeeAmount);\n        }\n\n        netFees = protocolFeeAmount + referralFeeAmount + managerFeeAmount;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Transfers fees, notifies the current settlement policy of        uint256 netAmount = _releaseAmount - netFees;\n\n        address vault;\n        IIntentSettlementPolicy.SettlementContext memory context;\n        if (address(policy) != address(0) && address(_token),\n                depositor: _depositor,\n                taker: _intent.owner,\n                recipient: _intent.to,\n                paymentMethod: _intent.paymentMethod,\n                releaseAmount: _releaseAmount,\n                netAmount: netAmount,\n                settlementData: _settlementData\n            });\n            vault = policy.settleIntent(context);\n        }\n\n        address fundsTransferredTo = _intent.to;\n        if (vault != address(0)) {\n            _token.safeTransfer(vault, netAmount);\n            policy.onDeferredPayoutFunded(context);\n            emit IntentPayoutDeferred(_intentHash, _intent.to, vault, netAmount);\n            fundsTransferredTo = vault;\n        } else {\n            // Otherwise transfer directly to the intent recipient\n            _token.safeTransfer(_intent.to, netAmount);\n        }\n\n        emit IntentFulfilled(\n            _intentHash, \n            fundsTransferredTo, \n            netAmount, \n            _releasedBy\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Checks if a intent gating service signature is valid.\n     */\n    function _isValidIntentGatingSignature(\n _intent.paymentMethod,\n            _intent.fiatCurrency,\n            _intent.conversionRate,\n            ReferralFeeLib.hashReferralFees(_intent.referralFees),\n            _intent.signatureExpiration,\n            chainId,\n            _intent.payerCommitment // Last and variable-length; empty keeps O3's message byte for byte\n        );\n\n        bytes32 verifierPayload = keccak256(message).toEthSignedMessageHash();\n        return _intentGatingService.isValidSignatureNow(verifierPayload, _intent.gatingServiceSignature);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xa5e27b056a26cb15115aa92eaadd9fdc00ac87713a0a2daf0c3db51045c0b0cc","license":"MIT"},"contracts/external/AddressArrayUtils.sol":{"content":"/*\n    Copyright 2020 Set Labs devdoc.title: OrchestratorV4

cancelIntent(bytes32).notice: Only callable by the originator or the arbitrator of the intent. Cancels an outstanding intent. Unlocks liquidity for the corresponding deposit on the escrow contract.

cleanupOrphanedIntents(bytes32[]).notice: ANYONE: Cleans up orphaned intents that were pruned from the Escrow but not from the Orchestrator. An intent is considered orphaned if it exists on the Orchestrator but no longer exists on the Escrow. This can happen when Escrow._tryOrchestratorPruneIntents runs out of gas and the revert is silently caught.

extendIntent(bytes32,uint256).notice: Only callable by the intent's arbitrator. Extends the intent's expiry for free, e.g. while a dispute is reviewed. The escrow must let this orchestrator extend (on EscrowV2, as the deposit's intent guardian) and caps the intent's total lifetime.

fulfillIntent((bytes,bytes32,bytes)).notice: Anyone can submit a fulfill intent transaction, even if caller isn't the intent owner. Upon submission the offchain payment proof is verified, payment details are validated, intent is removed, and escrow state is updated. Settlement unlocks escrow funds, transfers fees, notifies the current settlement policy (fail-closed), and transfers the net payout to intent.to or the deferral vault.

pauseOrchestrator().notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Pauses intent creation and fulfillment functionality.  Functionalities that are paused: - Intent creation (signalIntent) - Intent fulfillment (fulfillIntent) Functionalities that remain unpaused to allow users to recover funds: - Intent cancellation (cancelIntent) - Manual fund release by depositor or arbitrator (releaseFundsToPayer) - Intent extension by arbitrator (extendIntent) - Intent pruning by escrow (pruneIntents) - All governance functions - All view functions

pruneIntents(bytes32[]).notice: Only the escrow contract owns the intent can call this function. Called by escrow to prune specific expired intents. Escrow leads the cleanup process.

releaseFundsToPayer(bytes32,uint256).notice: Allows depositor or the intent's arbitrator to release funds to the payer in case of a failed fulfill intent, a dispute ruling, or some other arrangement between the two parties. Upon submission we check to make sure the msg.sender is the depositor or arbitrator, the intent is removed, and escrow state is updated. Manual release pays the recipient directly without calling the settlement policy.

setAllowMultipleIntents(bool).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Sets whether all accounts can signal multiple intents.

setEscrowRegistry(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the escrow registry address.

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the protocol fee. This fee is charged to takers upon a successful fulfillment of an intent.

setProtocolFeeRecipient(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the protocol fee recipient address.

setRelayerRegistry(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the relayer registry address.

setSettlementPolicy(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the global settlement policy.

signalIntent((address,uint256,uint256,ad.notice: Signals intent to pay the depositor defined in the _depositId the _amount * deposit conversionRate off-chain at  their given _payeeId in order to unlock _amount of funds on-chain. Caller must provide a signature from the deposit's gating service to prove their eligibility to take liquidity. This function captures and stores all values required for fullfilling the intent to give strong guarantees to the buyer. Checks whitelist admission and records whether the taker was whitelisted, and the arbitrator of the group the taker signals through, before locking liquidity for the corresponding deposit on the escrow contract.

unpauseOrchestrator().notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Restarts paused functionality for the orchestrator.

userdoc.notice: Standalone V4 orchestrator for the ZKP2P protocol. Owns the complete intent (order) lifecycle — signal, cancel, fulfill, manual release, prune, orphan cleanup — and extends it with a governance-selected settlement policy and deferred settlement.
